name: Wan (open-weight releases)

access.regionNotes: Open weights, self-hosted. No vendor API key and no vendor moderation layer, so the operator is responsible for access control, logging, and output review.

pricing.publicRate: No per-second vendor price. Cost is your own GPU hours. Commercial API resellers list roughly $0.07/s for Wan 2.6 at 2K.
pricing.note: Read 2026-09-05. Reseller figures are for hosted Wan, not self-hosting.

notes: Distinct from the wan-3.0 record, which is a verified hosted Atlas Cloud run. This record covers the open-weight, self-hosted path, which has NOT been run here.
The verified Wan 3.0 run in this database was the only request that honored both its requested duration and resolution. That is a single observation, not evidence about the open-weight line.
